page.content:
Developer who remade the brand as Friendship Is Magic and the Mane Six.

How Lauren Faust connects

  • Series: My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic — Lauren Faust developed Friendship Is Magic and the Mane Six.
  • Faction: Mane Six — Lauren Faust created the Mane Six as adventure-comedy leads.

What is Lauren Faust?

Lauren Faust developed My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic for Hasbro, writing Twilight Sparkle, Rainbow Dash, Pinkie Pie, and the rest of the Mane Six as adventure-comedy leads instead of only toy mascots.

Key threads lead to My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic and Mane Six.
